title: Vacuum-Form Signage
summary: An exploration of vacuum-formed signage, tracing the history and techniques behind illuminated signs that were prevalent in mid-century retail and commercial design. The article appears to cover the manufacturing process and aesthetic qualities of this signage method.
problem_solved: Documents and explains the historical manufacturing technique of vacuum forming used for illuminated signage
why_valuable: Preserves knowledge of a craft technique and provides historical context for retro-style illuminated signage that is experiencing renewed interest
